description_en: Unlike the ExecuteScalingRule API, you can use the ScaleWithAdjustment API to trigger elastic scaling based on a specified adjustment rule, without first creating a scaling rule
description_zh: 区别于ExecuteScalingRule接口，您无需提前创建伸缩规则，直接调用API ScaleWithAdjustment接口快速基于指定调整规则触发弹性扩缩容
kebab_example: aliyun ess scale-with-adjustment --scaling-group-id asg-j6c1o397427hyjdc0000 --adjustment-type QuantityChangeInCapacity --adjustment-value 100 --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ScaleWithAdjustment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The method used to adjust the number of instances in a scaling activity. Valid values:

`QuantityChangeInCapacity`: Adds or removes a specified number of ECS instances.

`PercentChangeInCapacity`: Adds or removes a specified percentage of ECS instances.

`TotalCapacity`: Adjusts the number of ECS instances in the scaling group to a specified number
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动调整方式，取值范围：

QuantityChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定数量的ECS实例。
PercentChangeInCapacity：增加或减少指定比例的ECS实例。
TotalCapacity：将当前伸缩组的ECS实例数量调整到指定数量
parameters.name: adjustment_type

parameters.help_en:
The adjustment value for the scaling activity. A single adjustment cannot add or remove more than 1,000 ECS instances. The valid range depends on `AdjustmentType`:

`QuantityChangeInCapacity`: -1000 to 1000.

`PercentChangeInCapacity`: -100 to 10000.

`TotalCapacity`: 0 to 2000
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动调整值。任何情况下，单次调整的ECS实例台数都不能超过1000，否则会导致调整失败。不同调整方式对应的取值范围：
QuantityChangeInCapacity：-1000~1000。
PercentChangeInCapacity：-100~10000。
TotalCapacity：0~2000
parameters.name: adjustment_value

parameters.help_en: The minimum number of instances to adjust in a scaling activity. This parameter takes effect only when `AdjustmentType` is set to `PercentChangeInCapacity`
parameters.help_zh: 伸缩活动最小调整实例数，仅当`AdjustmentType`为`PercentChangeInCapacity`时生效
parameters.name: min_adjustment_magnitude

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token to ensure the idempotence of the request. This token must be a unique string of up to 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to execute the scaling activity synchronously. This parameter applies only to scaling groups that are configured with an expected number of instances. Valid values:

`true`: Synchronous execution. The scaling activity is triggered immediately.

`false`: Asynchronous execution. The call updates the expected number of instances without immediately triggering the scaling activity. The activity occurs when the system detects a discrepancy between the new expected number and the current number of instances.

For more information about the expected number of instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146231.html.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动同步执行开关，仅对具有期望实例数配置项的伸缩组有效。取值范围：

true：同步流程，即执行伸缩规则时会直接触发伸缩组的扩缩容活动。
false：异步流程，即修改伸缩组内的期望实例数时，不会立刻触发伸缩组的实际扩缩容活动，需等待期望实例数变化后，系统自动检测期望实例数与伸缩组内当前实例数不一致，才会触发扩缩容活动。

关于期望实例数的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/146231.html。

默认值：false
parameters.name: sync_activity

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the current scaling activity supports concurrency
parameters.help_zh: 当前扩缩容任务是否支持并发
parameters.name: parallel_task

fields.help_en: The arguments for the container's startup command. You can specify up to 10 arguments
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令对应的参数。最多10个
fields.name: args

fields.help_en: The container's startup command, specified as an array of strings. You can specify up to 20 strings, and each can be up to 256 characters long
fields.help_zh: 容器启动命令。最多20个。每个命令最多包含256个字符
fields.name: commands

fields.help_en: The number of vCPUs for the container. Unit: cores
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en: The name of the environment variable. It must be 1 to 128 characters long, cannot start with a digit, and can contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), digits (0-9), and underscores (_)
fields.help_zh: 环境变量名。长度为1~128个字符。格式要求：`[0-9a-zA-Z]`，以及下划线（_），不能以数字开头
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the environment variable, up to 256 characters long
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: Environment variables to set in the container
fields.name: environment_vars

fields.help_en: The memory size for the container. Unit: GiB
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en: The name of the container to override. The override takes effect only if this name matches a container name in the scaling configuration
fields.help_zh: 容器名称。当需要覆写容器参数时，必须指定容器名称，容器名称与伸缩配置容器名称相匹配时，方可覆写容器参数
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The number of vCPUs for the instance. Unit: cores
fields.name: cpu

fields.help_en: The memory size for the instance. Unit: GiB
fields.help_zh: 实例级别内存大小。单位：GiB
fields.name: memory

fields.help_en: The user data for the ECS instance. It must be Base64-encoded, and the raw data cannot exceed 32 KB
fields.help_zh: ECS 实例的自定义数据，需要以 Base64 方式编码，编码前的原始数据最多为 32 KB
fields.name: user_data

parameters.help_en: The parameters to override when scaling out an ECI scaling group
parameters.help_zh: ECI伸缩组扩容指定覆写参数
parameters.name: overrides

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable all lifecycle hooks for the scaling activity. Valid values:

`true`: Disables all lifecycle hooks.

`false`: Does not disable lifecycle hooks
fields.help_zh:
伸缩活动禁用所有生命周期挂钩。取值范围：

true：禁用。
false：不禁用
fields.name: disable_lifecycle_hook

fields.help_en: A list of lifecycle hook IDs to ignore during the scaling activity
fields.help_zh: 伸缩活动禁用的生命周期挂钩ID列表
fields.name: ignored_lifecycle_hook_ids

parameters.help_zh: 生命周期挂钩上下文信息
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_context

parameters.help_en: The metadata for the scaling activity
parameters.name: activity_metadata

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode. Valid values:

`None`: Executes a standard scaling activity.

`PlanOnly`: Only performs elastic planning and returns the results in `PlanResult` without triggering the scaling activity. The results include details such as instance types, availability zones, billing methods, and the number of new instances.

Default value: None
parameters.help_zh:
执行模式
可选值：

None：未指定，正常扩缩容。
PlanOnly：不触发扩缩容，仅执行弹性规划，在PlanResult中返回规划的结果，包括实例规格、可用区ID、付费类型和创建的实例数量等信息。

默认为None
parameters.name: execution_mode

ActivityType.description_en:
The type of the scaling activity.

If this parameter is set to `CapacityChange`, the scaling activity only adjusts the desired capacity of the scaling group without immediately adding or removing instances.

This setting only affects scaling groups with a configured desired capacity
ActivityType.description_zh:
伸缩活动的类型。

当`ActivityType为CapacityChange`时，表示返回值`ScalingActivityId`对应伸缩活动仅修改伸缩组期望实例数，没有立刻执行扩缩。

适用范围：期望实例数类型伸缩组

PlanResult.description_en: The scaling plan result returned when ExecutionMode is set to PlanOnly
PlanResult.description_zh: 当ExecutionMode为PlanOnly时，返回的弹性规划的结果

ResourceAllocations.description_en: The resource allocation details in the scaling plan result
ResourceAllocations.description_zh: 弹性规划结果中的资源分配信息

InstanceChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

Prepaid: subscription

PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
InstanceChargeType.description_zh:
付费类型，返回值如下：
Prepaid：包年包月
Postpaid：按量付费

SpotStrategy.description_en:
The spot strategy of the instance. Valid values:

NoSpot: A pay-as-you-go instance.

SpotWithPriceLimit: A spot instance with a user-specified price limit.

SpotAsPriceGo: A spot instance where the system automatically bids based on the current market price
SpotStrategy.description_zh:
实例的抢占策略。取值范围：

NoSpot：正常按量付费实例。
SpotWithPriceLimit：设置上限价格的抢占式实例。
SpotAsPriceGo：系统自动出价，跟随当前市场实际价格的抢占式实例

ScalingActivityId.description_en: The ID of the scaling activity
